description: Plays a script of taps, drags, keys and waits on the virtual clock and returns a storyboard of every "shot" and "film" step. Use "until <js> <time>" to wait for game states instead of guessing.

area.description: CSS selector of the game area (default: the largest canvas)

ready.description: JavaScript expression that is true once the game has loaded

scenario.description: Name of a scenario in playproof.config.json: supplies steps, duration, zoom and device

steps.description: Required unless a scenario gives them. Steps separated by ";". Steps (separate with ";" or new lines, "#" starts a comment line): wait <time> let time pass (virtual time: instant and exact) tap <x,y>|@label tap/click inside the game area ("50%,80%" or pixels "120,300") press <x,y> <time> long press drag <x,y> <x,y> [time] swipe/drag (default 300ms) key <Key> [time] press a key, e.g. Space, ArrowLeft, a, Enter (held 50ms by default) type <text> type text click <css selector> click a DOM element (menus, HTML buttons) shot [label] take a screenshot for the storyboard film <time> [fps] capture frames while time passes until <js expression> [time] advance time until the expression is truthy (default timeout 5s) js <js expression> evaluate JavaScript in the page and log the result Times: 500, 500ms, 1.5s.

target.description: URL (e.g. http://localhost:5173), folder (./dist) or HTML file of the game. Optional when playproof.config.json sets it.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before starting

name: play
title: Play a scripted sequence
